# Lab 14.7: End-to-End RAG in SQL

## What We Are Going to Do
Build retrieval-augmented generation entirely in SQL: embed documents, retrieve the best matches for a question, and let Gemini answer using only those matches.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Embed the news articles once.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab14.news_emb AS
SELECT title, body, AI.EMBED(body, endpoint =&gt; 'text-embedding-005').result AS emb
FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext`;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Retrieve and generate in one query.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">DECLARE question STRING DEFAULT 'What happened with mobile phone sales and prices?';

WITH retrieved AS (
  SELECT base.title, base.body
  FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(TABLE lab14.news_emb, 'emb',
    (SELECT AI.EMBED(question, endpoint =&gt; 'text-embedding-005').result AS emb),
    top_k =&gt; 3, distance_type =&gt; 'COSINE')
)
SELECT
  AI.GENERATE(CONCAT(
    'Answer the question using ONLY the articles below. Cite article titles. ',
    'If the answer is not in them, say you do not know.\n\nQuestion: ', question,
    '\n\nArticles:\n', STRING_AGG(CONCAT('### ', title, '\n', body), '\n\n'))).result AS answer,
  ARRAY_AGG(title) AS sources
FROM retrieved;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Ask a question with no answer in the data.** Change `question` to `'Who won the 2026 cricket world cup?'`. The model should say it does not know.

4. **[CLI] Wrap it as a stored procedure.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE lab14.ask(question STRING)
BEGIN
  SELECT AI.GENERATE(CONCAT("Answer only from these articles, cite titles. Question: ", question, "\n\n",
    STRING_AGG(CONCAT("### ", base.title, "\n", base.body), "\n\n"))).result AS answer
  FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(TABLE lab14.news_emb, "emb",
    (SELECT AI.EMBED(question, endpoint =&gt; "text-embedding-005").result AS emb), top_k =&gt; 3);
END'
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'CALL lab14.ask("What did the articles say about broadband?")'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Retrieve | Top 3 articles by meaning |
| Augment | Articles added to the prompt |
| Generate | Answer with cited titles |
| Grounding | "I don't know" when the data has no answer |
